author: Karl Rock
description:
5,000 years ago, one of the world's most advanced civilisations built an incredible city here in Pakistan. Then, somehow, the Indus Valley Civilisation disappeared, and to this day, we still don't know exactly what happened to them.

Join me for a full guided tour of Mohenjo-daro in Sindh, Pakistan, one of the most fascinating archaeological sites in the world and one of the most important cities of the ancient Indus Valley Civilisation.

Rather than giving you a short edited highlights video, I wanted to take you along for a proper walking tour of the ruins with a local guide.

My guide, Irshad, has been working as a tour guide since 2007 and has a family connection to the archaeological site. His grandfather worked on excavations here in 1922 with British archaeologist Sir John Marshall, while his father worked for the Archaeology Department.

For guided tours of Mohenjo-daro, you can contact Irshad directly on WhatsApp: +92 0336 3417 549.
